design: 2 tool aliases × 2 neutral identifier strings × 3 prefix outcomes; one hand-authored template group; development only
hypothesis: Visible histories differ only in tool alias and identifier within an outcome; each retryable TIMEOUT can be resolved by executing one same-argument retry.
stop_conditions: Fail on missing/duplicate grid cell, divergent normalized public payload, hidden fields, unexpected simulator feedback, or ungrounded reference completion.
